close_reason: Took option (b): removed the false no_std claim from pkix-ct (dropped categories=['no-std'], the cfg_attr no_std line, the std feature, and the cfg(feature='std') gate on impl std::error::Error). pkix-ct is now plain std, matching the workspace policy that only pkix-path is required to be no_std.
description:
## Anchor
Pass-2 commit e586bc49 closed PKIX-qwzx.10 ("pkix-ct uses std::error::Error unconditionally without an std feature gate"). The fix:
- Added `#![cfg_attr(not(feature = "std"), no_std)]` at pkix-ct/src/lib.rs:1
- Added `[features] default = []; std = ["der/std", "x509-cert/std", "pkix-path/std"]` to pkix-ct/Cargo.toml
- Gated `impl std::error::Error for Error` behind `#[cfg(feature = "std")]`
- Added `categories = ["cryptography", "no-std"]` to Cargo.toml

## Finding
The fix is incomplete. `pkix-ct` depends on `x509-cert` (workspace dep, version "0.2") via `x509-cert = { workspace = true }` *without* `default-features = false`. `x509-cert 0.2` default features are `["pem", "std"]` (verified from cargo-metadata). So `x509-cert/std` is always pulled in, regardless of pkix-ct's std feature.

Reproduction:
```
cargo build -p pkix-ct --no-default-features --target riscv32imc-unknown-none-elf
```
Result: const-oid fails to compile with "can't find crate for std" — confirms x509-cert is always pulled with std=enabled, defeating pkix-ct's no_std cfg.

## Severity
P3. The crate is a stub (always returns Err(NoTrustedSct)) so this is not behaviorally observable. But:
- `categories = ["no-std"]` is a public crates.io claim — false advertising.
- The `#![cfg_attr(not(feature="std"), no_std)]` is a developer signal that breaks on real no_std targets.

## Fix
Either (a) add `default-features = false` to the x509-cert workspace dep AND propagate via std feature, OR (b) remove the `categories = ["no-std"]` claim and the no_std cfg until the underlying deps actually support it.

Per project AGENTS.md, only pkix-path is required to be no_std. pkix-ct could safely revert to std-only and remove the claim.

## Pass-2 attribution
PKIX-qwzx.10 closure was about std::error::Error feature gating; that part is correct. The simultaneous addition of `categories = ["no-std"]` and the `#![cfg_attr(not(feature = "std"), no_std)]` line introduced a new doc/manifest overclaim that wasn't asked for in PKIX-qwzx.10.
title: P3: pkix-ct claims category=no-std but does not compile on a no_std target
